```python
def get_user_posts(user_id):
    """Get all posts for a specific user"""
    url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts"
    params = {"userId": user_id}

    try:
        response = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=5)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()
    except requests.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        return []

posts = get_user_posts(1)
print(f"User 1 has {len(posts)} posts")
if posts:
    print(f"First post: {posts[0]['title']}")

    """Create a new post"""
    url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts"

    try:
        response = requests.post(url, json=data, timeout=5)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()
    except requests.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Error creating post: {e}")
        return None

# Create post
```

```python
def update_post_full(post_id, title, body, user_id):
    """Full update using PUT"""
    url = f"https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/{post_id}"
    data = {"id": post_id, "title": title, "body": body, "userId": user_id}

    try:
        response = requests.put(url, json=data, timeout=5)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()
    except requests.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        return None

def update_post_partial(post_id, **kwargs):
    """Partial update using PATCH"""
    url = f"https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/{post_id}"

    try:
        response = requests.patch(url, json=kwargs, timeout=5)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()
    except requests.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        return None

# Full update
updated = update_post_full(1, "Updated Title", "Updated Body", 1)
print(f"PUT update: {updated['title']}")

# Partial update
updated = update_post_partial(1, title="New Title Only")
print(f"PATCH update: {updated['title']}")
```

```python
class AuthenticatedAPI:
    def __init__(self, base_url, api_key=None):
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.session = requests.Session()

        if api_key:
            self.session.headers.update({"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"})

    def get(self, endpoint, **kwargs):
        """GET request"""
        url = f"{self.base_url}/{endpoint}"
        response = self.session.get(url, **kwargs)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()

    def post(self, endpoint, **kwargs):
        """POST request"""
        url = f"{self.base_url}/{endpoint}"
        response = self.session.post(url, **kwargs)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()

    def close(self):
        self.session.close()

try:
    api = AuthenticatedAPI("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com")
    posts = api.get("posts", params={"_limit": 2})
    print(f"Retrieved {len(posts)} posts using session")
finally:
    api.close()
```

sections.title: class RateLimitedClient
sections.body:
Make rate-limited request

```python
class RateLimitedClient:
    def __init__(self, requests_per_second=2):
        self.min_interval = 1.0 / requests_per_second
        self.last_request_time = 0

    def request(self, method, url, **kwargs):
        """Make rate-limited request"""
        # Calculate wait time
        elapsed = time.time() - self.last_request_time
        if elapsed < self.min_interval:
            wait_time = self.min_interval - elapsed
            time.sleep(wait_time)

        # Make request
        response = requests.request(method, url, **kwargs)
        self.last_request_time = time.time()
        return response

client = RateLimitedClient(requests_per_second=2)

print("Making 3 rate-limited requests...")
start = time.time()
for i in range(1, 4):
    response = client.request("GET", f"https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/{i}")
    print(f"  Request {i}: {response.status_code}")

elapsed = time.time() - start
print(f"Total time: {elapsed:.2f}s (rate-limited to ~2 req/s)")
```

```python
def fetch_all_pages(base_url, params=None, limit_per_page=10, max_pages=None):
    """Fetch all pages of results"""
    all_results = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        if max_pages and page > max_pages:
            break

        page_params = params.copy() if params else {}
        page_params["_page"] = page
        page_params["_limit"] = limit_per_page

        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=page_params, timeout=5)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            if not data:
                break

            all_results.extend(data)
            print(f"  Fetched page {page}: {len(data)} items")
            page += 1

        except requests.RequestException as e:
            print(f"Error on page {page}: {e}")
            break

    return all_results

print("Fetching paginated results:")
results = fetch_all_pages(
    "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts", limit_per_page=20, max_pages=3
)
print(f"Total items fetched: {len(results)}")
```

sections.title: request_with_retry()
sections.body:
Make request with exponential backoff retry

```python
def request_with_retry(url, max_retries=3, backoff_factor=2):
    """Make request with exponential backoff retry"""
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            response = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
            response.raise_for_status()
            return response

        except requests.RequestException as e:
            if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                print(f"All retries failed: {e}")
                raise

            wait_time = backoff_factor**attempt
            print(f"Attempt {attempt + 1} failed. Retrying in {wait_time}s...")
            time.sleep(wait_time)

try:
    response = request_with_retry("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1")
    print(f"Success: {response.status_code}")
except requests.RequestException:
    print("Request failed after retries")
```

sections.title: class APIResponse
sections.body:
Get value from response data

```python
class APIResponse:
    def __init__(self, response):
        self.status_code = response.status_code
        self.headers = dict(response.headers)

        try:
            self.data = response.json()
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            self.data = None

        self.success = 200 <= response.status_code < 300

    def get(self, key, default=None):
        """Get value from response data"""
        if isinstance(self.data, dict):
            return self.data.get(key, default)
        return default

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"APIResponse(status={self.status_code}, success={self.success})"

response = requests.get("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1")
api_response = APIResponse(response)

print(f"Response: {api_response}")
print(f"Title: {api_response.get('title')}")
print(f"Success: {api_response.success}")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("All exercises completed!")
print("=" * 70)
```
